cues.en: Enemies in Returnal have
tentacles that writhe as if alive.
For this kind of effect, the developers used
particles connected to one another.
Connected points follow one another’s motion.

cues.ko: 그 둘레에 굵은 표면을 만드는 과정을 보겠습니다.
cues.en: Then we will build a thick surface around them.
Follow the root and tip
of the tentacle separately.
Their motion is not identical at every instant,
which helps the shape feel flexible.

cues.ko: 처음에는 뼈대마다 물리 몸체를 붙이려 했습니다.
cues.en: The initial approach attached a physical body to each bone.

cues.ko: 하지만 계산 비용과 표현 조절에 어려움이 있었습니다.
cues.en: But computation cost and artistic control were difficult.

cues.ko: 개발진은 지피유 이펙트 도구에서 입자 구조를 발전시켰습니다.
cues.en: The team developed the particle structure in a GPU effects tool.
The points connect through parent and child relationships.
Adding a physical body along every long chain
creates many connections to simulate.
Particles let artists control the motion rules

cues.ko: 이펙트 도구에서 직접 조절할 수 있습니다.
cues.en: inside their effects tools.
Each child references one parent,

cues.ko: 부모에는 여러 자식이 달릴 수 있습니다.
cues.en: while a parent can have multiple children.

cues.ko: 자식은 부모의 한 프레임 전 정보를 사용합니다.
cues.en: A child uses its parent’s information from one frame earlier.
The parent moves first,
and later points follow with a delay,
producing organic motion.
Imagine a line of people, each following

cues.ko: 뒤 사람이 따라 하는 줄을 떠올려 보세요.
cues.en: the person ahead from a moment earlier.
The front has already turned
while the back bends a little later.

cues.ko: 모형의 점들이 따라가는 시간 차이를 보면
cues.en: The model’s delayed points

cues.ko: 부모와 자식의 관계가 더 잘 보입니다.
cues.en: make the parent-child relationship visible.
Moving points alone
do not make a thick tentacle visible.

cues.ko: 처음의 납작한 띠에서 원통형 표면으로 바꿨습니다.
cues.en: The initial flat ribbons became cylindrical surfaces.

cues.ko: 점들을 따라 부드러운 곡선을 만든 겁니다.
cues.en: Smooth curves are built along the points.
Even from the side or in shadow,
their volume remains readable.
Turn the ribbon sideways.
Only its thin edge is visible.
A cylinder keeps its round thickness
when viewed from different sides.
If the surface twists,
its lighting can rotate strangely too.
So the surface orientation
is inherited and refined from the parent
using an additional calculation.
The motion-driving points

cues.ko: 그 위에 안정적인 표면을 만드는 작업은 함께 필요합니다.
cues.en: and a stable surface built around them are both needed.
Stripes around a tube

cues.ko: 표면이 얼마나 뒤틀리는지 알 수 있죠.
cues.en: make its surface twist easier to see.
Smoothly connecting these orientations
also makes changes in lighting smoother.
This motion also connects to

cues.ko: 적이 공격을 준비할 때 같은 상태 표현에도 연결됩니다.
cues.en: states such as an enemy preparing an attack.
Artists and animators

cues.ko: 공격을 알아보기 쉽게 동작 시간을 조절했습니다.
cues.en: adjusted motion timing so attacks were easy to read.

cues.ko: 부모의 이전 움직임을 따라가는 입자가 있습니다.
cues.en: Particles follow the parent’s earlier movement.

cues.ko: 그 둘레의 표면과 함께 촉수의 생동감을 만듭니다.
cues.en: Together with the surrounding surface, they bring the tentacles to life.
Constantly waving is different from

cues.ko: 공격 준비에 맞춰 움직이는 것은 다릅니다.
cues.en: moving in step with an attack preparation.
This motion also helps players

cues.ko: 적의 공격 준비를 알아채는 데도 도움이 됩니다.
cues.en: notice an enemy preparing an attack.
